question: What are the names of the boats booked by people between age 20 and 30?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE students AS
SELECT sid, name, rating, age
FROM table_1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE boats AS
SELECT 
  bid,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mars), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(melon), '')) AS name
FROM table_2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE reserves AS
SELECT 
  xh AS sid,
  bh AS bid,
  day
FROM table_3
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "students" AS SELECT sid, name, rating, age FROM table_1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "boats" AS SELECT bid, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mars), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(melon), '')) AS name FROM table_2
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "reserves" AS SELECT xh AS sid, bh AS bid, day FROM table_3

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH boats_named AS (
    SELECT 
        bid,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mars), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(melon), '')) AS boat_name
    FROM table_2
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT r.sid, r.bid, r.day
    FROM table_3 r
    JOIN table_1 s ON s.sid = r.xh
    -- Note: table_3 columns appear as xh (sid), bh (bid); align via aliases below
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.boat_name
FROM (
    SELECT s.sid, s.age, r.bh AS bid
    FROM table_1 s
    JOIN table_3 r ON r.xh = s.sid
    WHERE s.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30
) q
JOIN boats_named b ON b.bid = q.bid
WHERE b.boat_name IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT b.name AS boat_name
FROM students s
JOIN reserves r ON r.sid = s.sid
JOIN boats b ON b.bid = r.bid
WHERE s.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30
ORDER BY boat_name
S:
# Produce distinct boat names for reservations made by students aged 20–30 (inclusive)
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT b.name AS boat_name
FROM students s
JOIN reserves r ON r.sid = s.sid
JOIN boats b ON b.bid = r.bid
WHERE s.age BETWEEN 20 AND 30
ORDER BY boat_name
""")
